column1: # The AMPSEQ_IDXx2 primer set encodes plate position: i5 gives the row (A-P),
# i7 gives the column (1-24). Together they define a 384-well map, so plate
# and well are derived from the index pair rather than recorded separately.
# Sequences are as reported in the index list (the orientation seen on the
# i5-forward strand after orientation normalisation). The i5 primer carries
# the index forward; the i7 primer carries its reverse complement, which the
# top strand reverses back - so both read as written here.
